proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
proposed.text: After Taserface's mutiny jails him, Yondu escapes with Rocket, Groot and Kraglin and helps the Guardians stop Ego. He dies in space saving Peter, and the Ravagers honor him at his funeral.

changes.evidence: In Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2, Taserface leads a mutiny and imprisons Yondu and Rocket; Kraglin and Groot free them, they join the fight against Ego, and Yondu sacrifices himself to save Quill in the vacuum of space. The file ends with Yondu 'At large' on Berhert and has no record of the mutiny, his switch to the Guardians' side, or his death.

now.title: Werewolf by Night
now.text: None of the hunters survives the bloody night at Bloodstone Manor.
cases: ST-102 The Massacre at Bloodstone Manor (Werewolf by Night)

proposed.text: Elsa kills three of the rival hunters and Ted kills the fourth, so none of them survives the night at Bloodstone Manor.

changes.evidence: Jack Russell, one of the five summoned hunters, survives, so 'none of the hunters survives' is wrong as written. Per the plot: Elsa kills one of the other hunters in the maze, Ted kills another, and Elsa later kills the two remaining hunters.
